sam_sales: Zenith POC reporting streaming failures during integration. Client shows JSON.parse errors and dropped SSE events. Demo scheduled in 2 hours, can we triage quickly? :grimacing:

kai_eng: Need request-id and client stack. Are they using our SDK or native EventSource?

sam_sales: Request-id rwd-bx-5599. They're on an Android WebView with a custom EventSource polyfill. Client logs: 'SyntaxError: Unexpected end of JSON input' and a truncated event: `data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"Hel` (cut).

kai_eng: Likely split SSE chunks or proxy coalescing. Quick fixes: 1) buffer 'data:' lines until blank-line separator, 2) use fetch-stream fallback, 3) add server heartbeat every 15s to keep intermediaries alive.

nina_sre: Infra checked rwd-bx-5599: connection up ~13s then closed with FIN. No 429s or auth errors. Recommend they run `curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream/chat?request_id=debug"` to capture raw SSE. If they sit behind nginx advise `proxy_buffering off; proxy_http_version 1.1; proxy_read_timeout 3600s; chunked_transfer_encoding on;`.

kai_eng: Small client snippet to buffer events: `let buf=''; source.onmessage = e => { buf += e.data + '\n'; if(buf.endsWith('\n\n')){ const payload = buf.replace(/(^data:\s*)/gm,'').trim(); buf=''; try{ handle(JSON.parse(payload)); }catch(e){ console.warn('partial'); } } };`

dev-bot: deploy 2026-04-12T09:40Z: heartbeat-canary enabled for /v1/stream/chat at 5%.

nina_sre: I'll monitor the canary and connection churn. If heartbeat increases reconnects we roll back. Also ask Zenith to paste first 4KB of raw stream (base64) and list any intermediate proxies (Cloudflare, Fastly, nginx).

sam_sales: Thanks — I'll ask them for raw bytes and push the nginx snippet. Sales note: if they request private deployment to avoid CDN quirks, explain lead time and infra config requirements on the call.

kai_eng: Action items: kai -> send fetch-stream example and buffer snippet (30m); nina_sre -> watch canary and logs (ongoing); sam_sales -> collect raw bytes and proxy chain (15m).

sam_sales: Appreciate it, team. Will update after we get the raw capture. :thumbsup:
